app_lock.settings_intro: App Lock asks for biometric confirmation - or your device password if biometrics aren't set up - each time you open re/notes and after it has been in the background for a while. Your notes stay encrypted on this device either way - this is a quick-access guard, not extra encryption.
app_lock.unavailable_desc: Add a fingerprint or face unlock in your device settings to use App Lock.

welcome.title: Working offline, no account
welcome.subtitle: You're using re/notes without an account. Here's what that means:
welcome.point_storage: Your notes stay on this device and never reach our servers.
welcome.point_no_sync: No sync across devices and no cloud backup.
welcome.point_no_recovery: There's no recovery if you lose this device or clear app data - export a backup regularly.
welcome.point_upgrade: You can create an account anytime - your notes will be kept and start syncing.

local_mode.backup_hint: Tip: export a backup before creating an account or signing in elsewhere.
local_mode.replace_desc: You're using re/notes without an account. Signing in replaces the notes on this device with the account's data. Export a backup first if you want to keep them.

passcode.settings_item_desc: Local (no-account) mode: lock this device with a passcode that encrypts your local key
passcode.settings_intro: This option is only for local (no-account) mode. A local passcode encrypts your data key on this device. You'll enter it each time you open the app after closing it. There is no recovery - if you forget it, the local data is lost.
passcode.setup_desc: Encrypt your local key with a passcode. Without one, the key is stored unencrypted on this device.
passcode.change_desc: Enter your current passcode and choose a new one.
passcode.min_length: Passcode must be at least {min} characters.
passcode.save_failed: Could not save the passcode. Please try again.
passcode.lock_now_desc: Lock the app and require the passcode again.
passcode.remove_desc: Stop encrypting the local key with a passcode.
passcode.remove_confirm_desc: Remove the passcode? Your local key will be stored unencrypted on this device again.
passcode.locked_desc: Your data is locked on this device. Enter your passcode to unlock it.
passcode.reset_desc: There is no way to recover a forgotten passcode. You can reset the app, but this permanently erases all local data on this device.

onboarding.title: Your daily note
onboarding.body: This is your note for today. Each day has its own daily note — clicking “Today” returns you to the same note all day long. Tomorrow's click will create a new one for the new date.
onboarding.tip: Weekly and monthly notes are off by default. You can enable them in the settings below.

onboarding.title: Your weekly note
onboarding.body: This is a shared note for the entire week (Monday–Sunday). No matter which day you click “This week”, you return to the same note. Next week's click will create a new one.
onboarding.tip: The title contains the date of this week's Monday and the ISO week number (e.g. 2026-05-04 W19).

onboarding.title: Your monthly note
onboarding.body: This is a shared note for the whole month. Whichever day you click “This month”, you return to the same note. Next month's click will create a new one.
onboarding.tip: The title contains the year and month (e.g. 2026-05).

storage.title: Storage Usage
storage.warning: You are approaching the storage limit
storage.exceeded: Storage limit exceeded. Delete or reduce notes.
storage.info: Notes in Markdown format are very lightweight - a typical note takes only 5-50 KB. 100 MB means room for thousands of notes, depending on their length and the number of saved versions in the edit history. For comparison - that's the equivalent of dozens of books of text. Reborn Apps are free and developed by a non-profit foundation - if there is demand for more storage and community support makes it possible, the limits will be increased.

export_import.dedup_prompt_folder: What should happen when a note with the same name already exists in the same folder?

export_import.preserve_tags_desc: Tags from the file are merged with the note's existing tags instead of replacing them. Stars and pins are never affected by import.
export_import.rewrite_links_desc: Relative Markdown links and Obsidian wikilinks between the imported files (e.g. [text](../other.md) or [[Note]]) become internal note links that open in the app. Links to files outside this import are left unchanged.

export_import.folder_sync_desc: Link folders of Markdown files on your disk - changes are re-imported automatically. One-way (disk → app).
export_import.folder_sync_hub_desc: Mirror local folders of Markdown files into your notes
export_import.folder_sync_limit_hint: Up to {max} folders can be linked.
export_import.folder_sync_name_desc: The app folder notes import into. Use a slash to nest, e.g. Projects/Docs. If the folder (or path) already exists, imports merge into it.
export_import.folder_sync_name_taken: Another linked folder already uses this name.
export_import.folder_sync_unsupported: Your browser doesn't support folder access (File System Access API). Use Chrome or Edge. In Brave it's off by default - enable the File System Access API in brave://flags, then restart the browser.
export_import.folder_sync_no_full_path: Only the folder's name is available - your browser doesn't expose a folder's full path on disk. You can add your own label (Edit) to recognize it or tell two same-named folders apart.
export_import.folder_sync_no_full_path_native: Only the folder's name is available - the system doesn't expose a folder's full path on disk to the app. You can enter your own source path or label (Edit) to note where it is or tell two same-named folders apart.
export_import.folder_sync_source_label_desc: A label to recognize the on-disk folder, since only its name is available (not the full path). Add e.g. a path to tell two same-named folders apart. Display only - it doesn't change which folder is synced.
export_import.folder_sync_dest_edit_desc: The app folder notes import into. Use a slash to nest. Changing it moves the existing folder (with its notes) to the new path.
export_import.folder_sync_name_invalid: The folder name can't contain a backslash.
export_import.folder_sync_name_cycle: A folder can't be moved inside itself. Choose a different path.
export_import.folder_sync_auto_desc: Re-scans when you return to the app and every 5 minutes while it stays open.
export_import.folder_sync_safety_note: Sync never deletes notes: files removed or renamed on disk leave the existing notes in place. Unlinking keeps everything imported.
export_import.folder_sync_needs_permission: Folder access expired (the browser was restarted). Re-authorize to continue syncing.
export_import.folder_sync_error_gone: The linked folder was not found on disk (moved or deleted?). Restore it or unlink.
export_import.folder_sync_error_failed: Folder sync failed. Check the folder and try again.
export_import.folder_sync_up_to_date: Everything up to date - no changes on disk since the last sync.
